title: Crowded-positioning forced-unwind reversal: percentile-extreme states of official spec-vs-commercial geometry on commodity ETP legs

blindness_declaration.law: This document is authored before anyone measures anything for this lane. It declares a mechanism, a rule FAMILY and a representation identity. It contains no outcome numbers, no returns conditional on states, no expectancies, and no signal arithmetic on positioning or prices beyond the structural facts committed in the P0/P1/P2 artifacts (report counts, census identities, release-clock facts, cost constants). All rule parameters are SYMBOLIC and freeze at D2/S selection, never after any scored number.

mechanism.narrative: Large reporting speculators (the 'noncommercial' accounts of the legacy futures-only CFTC Commitments of Traders report) are leveraged, mark-to-market participants with finite risk capital. When their net geometry in a futures market reaches a percentile extreme of its own history, the crowd is maximally one-sided: further participation requires new capital while existing open-position gains must be defended with margin. At that state the FORCED participant is the crowded speculator himself: his unwind is not a view but a mechanical consequence of adverse moves (margin calls, risk-limit breaches, redemptions), and it must be executed INTO one-sided liquidity - the unwind of a maximally one-sided crowd moves the market against nobody's opinion and everybody's position. On the other side of the same extreme sits the commercial hedger, whose hedge is the mechanical shadow of physical inventory or forward commitments; at spec-crowded extremes his inventory constraint is binding - he has already hedged what he holds and cannot mechanically absorb more. The LATE participant is non-reporting small-trader and ETP-linked flow, which historically crowds in latest and provides the exit liquidity a forced unwind consumes. The proposal conditions on the OFFICIAL geometry alone: the weekly state is the percentile bucket of the committed structural identity (net noncommercial minus net commercial, normalized by open interest) computed from consecutive PIT-visible reports. No price input enters the state; no return is conditioned on it here. The declared rule family is a reversal-conditioning family: at extreme buckets the state arms a position opposing the crowded side per a frozen symmetric sign convention; at non-extreme buckets the state is inert. The mechanism's content is that the state identifies WHO IS FORCED - the extremeness of the official geometry, not any price pattern, is the information.

forced_participant.who: the crowded large reporting speculator at a positioning percentile extreme (and, mirror-side, the inventory-constrained commercial hedger who can no longer mechanically add)
forced_participant.why_forced: margin, risk-limit and redemption mechanics force de-risking into one-sided liquidity once the crowd is maximally one-sided; the commercial counterparty has already hedged the physical book, so absorption capacity is exhausted exactly at the extreme
forced_participant.late_participant: non-reporting small traders and ETP-linked retail flow, which crowd in latest and supply the exit liquidity the forced unwind needs

mechanism.information_source: official CFTC legacy futures-only reports only (committed P0 structural fields: open_interest, noncomm_long, noncomm_short, noncomm_spreading, comm_long, comm_short, per weekly as-of date); no prices, no vendor positioning estimates, no survey data
mechanism.state_definition_symbolic: state(t) = tail-bucket of g(r_t), where g(r) = ([noncomm_long - noncomm_short] - [comm_long - comm_short]) / open_interest, and r_t is the newest PIT-visible report at decision instant t; the rolling window length w and the two symmetric tail cuts q_lo, q_hi are SYMBOLIC, frozen at D2/S, never after; direction convention: opposite the crowded side, frozen symmetric in the two tails; outside the tails the state is inert
mechanism.q16_instrument_note: the tradeable instrument is the ETP leg, not the future; tracking/roll drag of the leg is part of the mechanism (Q-16) and is carried in the P1 tier-2.0 cost ladder plus measured expense facts and same-underlying tracking proxies (see representation_identity.q16_instrument_declaration)

decision_rule_family: state-conditioned weekly reversal family on the ETP leg: while state(t) is in a symmetric extreme tail of the official positioning geometry, hold a position opposing the crowded side for a symbolic holding window h (decision-session closes); otherwise flat; percentile window w, tail cuts q_lo/q_hi and holding window h are SYMBOLIC parameters, frozen at D2/S selection and never tuned after any scored number; identical family shape for both tails under a frozen symmetric sign convention

representation_identity.law: P-12: code AND representation are committed before any number is cited; this declaration names the exact representation and cites every committed artifact by sha256; nothing here is measured and no signal is computed at D1

grid.definition: weekly decision grid per qualifying market-pair, materialized by the committed P2 census: every measured weekly CoT report with release date >= 2018-01-01, first 52 window instants declared warmup carve-out, counted window thereafter; bookable instants only
grid.release_instant: Friday 15:30 America/New_York (DST-correct) of the Mon-Sun week containing the report's as-of date; Tuesday as-of dates use the frozen P0 rule verbatim (cot_census.release_instant, single source); the measured holiday-shifted Monday as-of dates take the same week anchor with identity to the P0 rule asserted at census time; instants are UTC-normalized (20:30Z in EST weeks, 19:30Z in EDT weeks)
grid.decision_session: first MEASURED ETP session STRICTLY AFTER the release date (research/assets/commodities_ng1/clock.py::next_session_after, fail-closed when the calendar is exhausted); the single unmapped counted release per pair (2026-09-11) is this clock law, never a fabricated session
grid.decision_instant: the decision session's EOD close instant (16:00 America/New_York; 20:00Z in EDT weeks, 21:00Z in EST weeks)

q16_instrument_declaration.law: Q-16: the instrument is the asset - ETP tracking/roll drag is part of the mechanism, not noise; it is declared here, measured in the P1 contract, and carried in the cost ladder (primary tier 2.0)
q16_instrument_declaration.content: each arm holds the ETP leg itself; the drag bill accrues with the (symbolic) holding window h and is carried as: (a) transaction component = 2 fills x half-spread CS p90 at stress tier 2.0, cost once per fill; (b) instrument expense accrued linearly over the declared horizon where MEASURED_OFFICIAL_PAGE (official page sha-pinned per leg in p2_gate.json item3); (c) same-underlying tracking divergence measured per leg in p1_cost_contract.json tracking_proxy (e.g. gold pair set BAR/GLD, GLD/IAU, GLD/SGOL) stands as the declared Q-16 instrument fact; basket leg DBA carries the dispatch-declared basket basis (purity 'basket' recorded per pair in p2_gate.json per_pair_census); the mechanism NARRATIVE predicts states whose holding horizons are weekly-scale, so drag is a participation cost the family must overcome - it is never assumed away

ancestry_risk_statement.declaration: This proposal names the pooled kill-candidate shadows it must be novel against (plan section 1; D2 pooled |rho| screen) and states, per shadow, why official positioning information differs. This is the claim D2 will test; if any claim is false, the proposal dies at D2 by the pooled screen or by its own battery.

named_kill_candidates.why_different: momentum_63s is a time-series price-momentum clock: its state is a function of past prices only. This proposal's state is a percentile bucket of official report geometry (committed noncommercial/commercial counts over open interest) with NO price input at declaration time; the state exists on weeks where price trajectories are unremarkable and is blind to them. Honest admission: if in-sample the extreme-geometry bucket turns out to select weeks that a trailing-price-momentum form selects identically (state rho beyond the frozen novelty ceiling), that is precisely the momentum_63s veto class plus the mandatory price-only shadow in this battery, and the proposal dies
named_kill_candidates.shadow_class: momentum_63s (generic price momentum; pooled D2 veto set)

named_kill_candidates.why_different: generic_dow_tue is a bare weekday clock: any arm that is only 'the CoT release weekday' with a fixed direction is that dead family. Here the release clock defines only WHEN information becomes tradeable (the decision grid); the state is the positioning geometry itself, which varies week to week and is inert in non-extreme weeks - a fixed weekday direction cannot reproduce a state that is flat most weeks and flips side by geometry. The release-clock shadow arm is the designated executioner if the bare weekly clock explains everything
named_kill_candidates.shadow_class: generic_dow_tue (calendar-clock forms; the CoT release weekday geometry)

named_kill_candidates.why_different: v16-class forms fade short-horizon price displacement at daily clocks. This family's reversal direction is set by the official geometry (opposing the crowded POSITIONING side), not by fading a price move, and its decision clock is the weekly release grid, not a daily displacement clock; the two can disagree for months (crowd extreme while price consolidates, and vice versa). Honest admission: A4-P1 IS reversal-flavoured, so the risk is real by construction - the price-only shadow (a displacement-percentile reversal on the identical weekly clock) is its designated executioner, and the D2 pooled screen carries the v16 veto
named_kill_candidates.shadow_class: v16_close_displace_fade (short-horizon price reversal; pooled D2 veto set)

arms.name: extreme-geometry reversal arm
arms.spec: the declared rule family: weekly position on the ETP leg opposing the crowded positioning side while state(t) sits in a symmetric extreme tail of the official geometry; symbolic parameters w, q_lo, q_hi, h
arms.kill_semantics: anchor; killed by any designated KILLER control out-earning it (see falsification_rule)

arms.name: price-only displacement-reversal shadow (MANDATORY, plan section 1)
arms.spec: the SAME tradeable rule (same clock, same holding shape, same symmetric sign convention, same symbolic parameters) with the positioning coordinate REPLACED by a price-only analogue: the percentile tail of trailing ETP price displacement over window w read under the same V7 close+1 convention; NO CoT input whatsoever; if the positioning family cannot beat its own price-only re-clock, the family is price momentum in disguise and dies
arms.kill_semantics: DESIGNATED KILLER: out-earns the anchor => the official geometry adds nothing over trailing price displacement (momentum_63s / v16 class) and the proposal dies

arms.name: bare release-clock shadow
arms.spec: identical holding shape and execution, FIXED direction sign, no state at all: every grid instant pooled (the bare Friday-release weekly clock)
arms.kill_semantics: DESIGNATED KILLER: out-earns the anchor => the state adds nothing over the generic release weekday clock (generic_dow_tue class) and the proposal dies

arms.name: stale-release placebo
arms.spec: the identical state machinery fed the report k release-instants OLDER than the PIT-visible one (k symbolic, >= 4 releases, frozen at selection): preserves the weekly clock and the state's marginal geometry while destroying the release-aligned information; Q-11: if staleness leaves too few eligible instants, the arm is invalid/NOT_RUN, never zero
arms.kill_semantics: DESIGNATED KILLER: out-earns the anchor => the effect is release-information-independent and the proposal dies

arms.name: two-delay placement pair
arms.spec: the identical anchor rule evaluated at D0 = the P2 later-bound decision session and D1 = the next session after D0; both reported side by side
arms.kill_semantics: diagnostic for clock-placement artifacts; informs the D2 report, does not kill alone

arms.name: clairvoyant ceiling arm (Q-4)
arms.spec: same holding shape, but tail membership and side granted full-sample knowledge no live PIT process could have; ceiling reference only
arms.kill_semantics: NEVER selectable at S (P-15 smoke kills-never-selects); bounds what a perfect oracle of this state could earn; invalid vs null recorded (Q-11)

falsification_rule.statement: KILL if, at D2/I on the identical bookable grid, restricted leg set and window under the identical frozen cost treatment, ANY designated KILLER control (the price-only displacement-reversal shadow, the bare release-clock shadow, or the stale-release placebo) earns a strictly greater after-cost per-decision edge than the ANCHOR arm. The price-only shadow matching the anchor means the positioning family reduces to price displacement (momentum_63s / v16 class); the release-clock shadow matching the anchor means the state adds nothing over the generic release weekday; the stale-release placebo matching the anchor means the release-aligned official information carries nothing. Declared now, outcome-blind; measurable later from the committed arms alone.
